messages:
marta: Heads-up: ACME sent their security spreadsheet (KMS, RBAC, audit) and asked for a short live review tomorrow. They specifically called out envelope encryption, key rotation proof, and audit retention to 2 years. Who can own the answers?

jess: I can take the questionnaire items re: RBAC and logging. Can we get sample audit export and KMS key policy? @samir can you export a sanitized audit slice?

samir: Yes. Will run an export from prod-audit for last 90d, strip PII. Which SIEM format do they want? jsonl or syslog?

marta: jsonl preferred. They want examples of: access logs for key usage, role assignment change events, and encryption-at-rest proof.

lin: For encryption-at-rest proof we can provide KMS metadata: key id, rotation schedule, KMS backed-by HSM info. I'll prepare a short one-pager.

jess: Also need to confirm service-account separation: customer data plane keys are not shared across tenants. Quick note: we use envelope encryption with per-tenant DEKs and a tenant-specific KMS key.

marta: Good. Also ACME asked about emergency key rotation playbook and split custody. Do we have a runbook link?

samir: There's an internal runbook: /runbooks/kms-rotation.md (private). Excerpt: 
```
# Emergency KMS rotation
1) Create new key with same policy
2) Rewrap active DEKs
3) Switch config flag `kms.current_key`
4) Monitor audit logs for errors
```

marta: Can someone grab a sanitized audit sample showing a DEK rewrap event? They want to see the fields we log.

infra-bot: export job started: audit-export-1768123456 -> s3://redwood-exports/sec-review/1768123456.jsonl (sanitization enabled)

samir: Export done. Pushed sample to the share. Pasted minimal sample below (sanitized): 
```
{"ts":"2026-06-14T15:02:03Z","event":"kms.rewrap","actor":"svc-terraform","tenant":"acme-corp","key_id":"redwood-prod-eu-1","result":"success"}
```

jess: That looks good. We should also provide log retention policy and proof of backup immutability.

lin: Retention is 730 days for audit indexes; backups are WORM-enabled + checksum. I'll add the verification note.

marta: One more: ACME asked about RBAC change approvals and audit trail for role elevation. Can we show approval flow?

jess: We log role changes with an approval_id field and link to ticketing. Example: 
```
{"ts":"2026-06-12T09:14:00Z","event":"rbac.role_assign","actor":"admin-ops","target":"user:alice","role":"dedicated_admin","approval_id":"JIRA-5432"}
```

samir: Also flagged: CVE-2026-1234 affects a transitive dep in our uploader. We're triaging — will have patch plan by EOD.

marta: Add that to the review call notes and tell ACME we have an open mitigation and timeline.

lin: Can we schedule the call at 10am PT tomorrow?

jess: Works for me. Invite sent to acme-sec@example.com and cc: @marta @samir @lin.

marta: Thanks. Action items: jess - questionnaire answers + RBAC examples; samir - sanitized audit export + vuln mitigation summary; lin - KMS one-pager + retention proof. I'll assemble and send pre-read.

sec-bot: Reminder: create evidence bundle ticket in `SEC-REVIEWS` board and attach artifacts.

marta: Created SEC-REVIEWS-2026. Leaving notes there.

samir: Uploading vuln patch PR link and export artifacts now.

jess: Pre-read sent to ACME. Will update thread with any follow-ups. :thumbsup:
